visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy with a black bowl-cut fringe, wearing a black zip-up jacket over a grey hoodie and light blue pants, stands in a brightly lit clothing retail store. He holds a pink shopping bag and gently touches a white, feathery shaggy dress hanging on a rack. (2) The boy picks up the white dress and walks through the store aisles toward a counter, smiling and showing excitement. The background features rows of neutral-colored clothing and minimalist decor. (3) The boy is seen waiting at a grey service counter, looking up at an unseen clerk while holding the white garment. (4) The scene shifts to a fitting room area with a large circular grey curtain track. A young woman, the mother, emerges from behind the curtain wearing the white shaggy dress over her casual cream-colored sweatshirt. She poses and laughs. (5) A man wearing glasses, a grey hoodie, and a brown corduroy jacket walks through the store. (6) The mother shows the dress to the man, who is presumably the father, while the boy stands nearby watching them with a happy expression. (7) Close-up shots show the mother's playful facial expressions as she reacts to the father's comments, with the store interior and a computer monitor visible in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, upbeat acoustic guitar BGM. A woman's voice (Mom) speaks in an animated, high-pitched tone, encouraging a young boy. The boy responds with a high, energetic voice. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect triggers as the boy is seen at the counter. The BGM continues steadily. (3) Fabric rustling is audible as the boy handles the clothes. The woman's laughter is frequent and melodic. (4) A comic 'pop' sound effect accompanies a jump cut. The mother makes an exaggerated vocal 'ta-da' sound as she reveals her dress. (5) A man's voice (Dad) enters with a calm, eye-level conversational tone. The woman sings a short, playful orchestral-style fanfare. (6) A cartoon-style 'boing' sound effect plays to emphasize a comedic moment as the father reacts to the dress. The BGM fades out slightly towards the end.
